summary: A small, non-interactive label that classifies the thing next to it. Presentational — no role, no live region.
useWhen: labelling a record's status, type, count or category
the label belongs to something else on the page and is read as part of it

useInstead.when: the message is a standalone statement the user must read
useInstead.why: Badge carries no role and is not announced on its own

useInstead.when: the label should be clickable — a filter chip, a removable tag
useInstead.why: Badge takes no focus and fires nothing

neutral.use: the default — a category with no judgement attached

success.use: a terminal good state: Active, Paid, Passed

warning.use: needs attention but is not broken: Pending, Expiring

error.use: a failed or blocked state: Failed, Overdue, Rejected

information.use: a neutral fact worth marking: Draft, Scheduled

sm.use: the default. 20px tall on caption type — a marker beside a row, a cell or a title

md.use: 24px on body-sm. Use when the badge sits in body copy and a caption-sized label would read as a footnote

lg.use: 32px. A page-level status the eye should reach before the prose, not a marker in a list

pill.use: the default. Fully round at every size

rounded.use: a squarer corner that steps with the size — 4/6/8. Use when the badge sits in a grid of rectangular things and a pill reads as the odd one out

icon.note: mutually exclusive with `dot` — `dot` wins and `icon` is dropped when both are set

guarantees: the dot marker is `aria-hidden`, so the badge announces its text only
no `status` or `alert` role, so a re-render never interrupts a screen reader
notes: If the value genuinely changes and the change matters, wrap the Badge in your own live region — the component will not do it for you.

antiPatterns.dont: relying on intent colour alone to carry the meaning
antiPatterns.why: colour is not a label (WCAG 1.4.1); the text has to say Failed, not just be red

antiPatterns.dont: putting a Button or Link inside a Badge
antiPatterns.why: it renders a plain <span>; interactive content there has no affordance and no focus style
